## Purpose
The turns of a refine conversation. Each proposal is shown as a reviewable change with apply and discard, and nothing is applied without the user pressing Apply.

## Responsibilities
- The user side: `UserTurn` (with `FocusChips`).
- The assistant side: `AssistantShell` / `AssistantAvatar`, `AssistantTurn`, `PendingTurn`.
- Each proposal shows a sentence summary (`Prose`), counts (`DiffStats`, `StatChip`), whether it fixes or introduces problems (`ValidationDelta`), the full change list (`DiffList`, `DiffRow`, `FieldValue`), `Notes`, `ProposalCard` and `ProposalActions`.
